proposedRoleDescriptions.color: Keep the UI palette restrained and separate it from colors shown inside project screenshots.
proposedRoleDescriptions.typography: A small, consistent hierarchy can carry identity, links and project descriptions; very thin text should be checked at real display sizes.

limits.semanticRoles: Null roles are deliberate. Element measurements do not establish canonical site-wide roles or scales.
limits.visibility: Nonzero element geometry does not prove visibility through loaders or overlays. Computed family requests do not prove successful font loading.
limits.coverage: Selected desktop samples and a supplied reference image when available; no complete responsive, interaction or accessibility audit.
limits.sourceDifferences: The live page has limited semantic text samples. The reference supports composition, not complete component or mobile coverage.
limits.ownership: Third-party reference, not an approved production pack.
